title.zh: SmartLingo 语言菜单顺序与外部点按修复
title.en: SmartLingo language order and outside-tap dismissal

purpose.zh: 按 Guandan 已验证的顺序显示全部 13 种界面语言，并让桌面与触屏用户点按弹窗外即可关闭。
purpose.en: Show all 13 interface languages in Guandan's verified order and close the popover on an outside click or tap.

zh: 界面语言从中文（简体）、中文（繁體）开始，后续语言与 Guandan 顺序一致；桌面与汉堡菜单使用同一列表。
移除拦截触屏外部点按的透明遮罩，复用 Guandan 的文档级外部点击和 Escape 关闭交互。
en: Start the shared desktop and hamburger language list with Simplified and Traditional Chinese, then follow Guandan's remaining locale order.
Remove the transparent full-page control that intercepted touch events; reuse Guandan's document-level outside-pointer and Escape dismissal.

zh: 所有使用共享页眉的页面、界面语言弹窗和汉堡菜单。
en: All shared-header pages, the interface-language popover, and the hamburger language list.

zh: 沿用 Guandan 的语言顺序、双列紧凑布局与文档级外部点按关闭方式，仅保留 SmartLingo 的品牌和路由适配。
新增语言顺序与外部点按行为回归测试；不修改学习语言、会员或付款数据。
en: Reuse Guandan's locale order, compact two-column layout, and document-level outside-pointer dismissal with only SmartLingo branding and route adapters.
Add behavioral regressions for order and outside taps without changing learning, membership, or payment data.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、菜单行为回归测试、生产构建与敏感数据扫描。
WebKit 中英文多尺寸布局检查；发布后在真实浏览器点按弹窗外并核对线上 Project 发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, menu behavior regressions, production build, and sensitive-data scan.
WebKit Chinese/English viewport checks, followed by real-browser outside-tap acceptance and exact production Project record verification.

zh: 本次不涉及付款、实时音视频或会员数据变更。
en: Payments, live media, and membership data are outside this language-menu change.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的 12 种学习语言数据与独立学习目标；本次仅调整 13 种界面语言的显示顺序和弹窗交互。
en: Keep SmartLingo's 12 learning-language records and independent learning target; only the 13 interface-language display order and popover interaction change.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，回退本次代码发布；没有数据库迁移。
rollback.en: Revert this code release if needed; there is no database migration.
